hebrewText: אָח֣וֹר וָ/קֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑/נִי וַ/תָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣/י כַּפֶּֽ/כָה

tokens.bdb: the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West
tokens.kjv: after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without.

tokens.bdb: the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward)
tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).

tokens.bdb: to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile)
tokens.kjv: adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclose, lay siege, put up in bags.

tokens.bdb: to place (in a very wide application)
tokens.kjv: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
tokens.kjv: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal
